head: codex/5820-v092-runtime-launch-resilience
title: [v0.92][WP-03] Runtime launch and resilience consolidation
body:
## Summary

- consolidate Runtime launch, ownership, restart, and shutdown behavior under the production Guardian
- preserve authenticated HTTPS and WSS service across sustained lifecycle exercise and forced recovery
- retain portable, digest-bound native proof artifacts and exact-head verification

## Resilience proof

- macOS native stress: 100/100 ten-second windows, 1,954 lifecycle cycles in one Guardian generation, and one forced child restart
- Linux AWS Spot native stress: 100/100 ten-second windows, 3,177 lifecycle cycles in one Guardian generation, and one forced child restart
- both lanes prove authenticated HTTPS/WSS, durable continuity, clean shutdown, and exact product revision
- focused Guardian lifecycle suite passes 10/10; AWS lane regression and final native receipt closure pass
- a clean detached checkout reconstructs and verifies the retained compressed native proof archives

## Platform boundary

Native Windows remains explicitly blocked under AC-7 and is not claimed as passed.

## Resource cleanup

All task-owned AWS compute is terminated. The temporary EBS volume is deleted and independently re-queried as absent; the abandoned temporary artifact bucket was empty and deleted.

Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5820
